reserveReview.rationale: Mento documents one shared reserve whose live allocation spans stablecoins, protocol positions, native cryptoassets, liquidity pools, safes, and governance-approved strategies. The analytics API is mutable and does not provide an immutable report artifact, so exact observed weights are intentionally left to the existing Mento live-reserve adapter rather than persisted as durable static facts.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Mento Reserve documented backing envelope with exact allocation supplied at runtime by the existing Mento adapter
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The static record identifies the complete shared-reserve envelope but does not assign changing constituent weights. Current allocation, venue balances, and strategy exposure must come from the timestamp-validated live adapter.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The mutable API exposes current constituents, but no immutable report supports durable static weights across the mixed reserve basket.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Mento documents reserve safes, liquidity contracts, operational accounts, and approved strategies, but their live shares are mutable. Public materials do not establish legal segregation, insolvency treatment, or strategy-specific reuse limits, so no static provider allocation is inferred.
